content.title: RBC Heritage
content.text: A PGA TOUR Signature Event Congratulations to Matt Fitzpatrick, winner of the 2026 RBC Heritage Presented by Boeing. Every year, the world’s best golfers compete in the RBC Heritage Presented by Boeing held at the legendary Harbour Town Golf Links. Considered a favorite among PGA TOUR players, the tournament regularly attracts more than 100,000 spectators.April 13-19, 2026 Tournament History Sea Pines founder Charles E. Fraser established the Heritage in 1969, creating a tournament that has raised millions for charity while putting The Sea Pines Resort on the world map. RBC Heritage Tickets From weeklong ticket packages to daily grounds or hospitality tickets, experience the best of The Sea Pines Resort. Previous Winners Arnold Palmer, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson, Greg Norman and Davis Love III, some of the biggest names in the history of golf, are just a few of the distinguished champions of the RBC Heritage. Fraser's Tavern at the Pavilion Located at the Harbour Town Clubhouse Halfway House (adjacent to the 10th tee)Fraser's Tavern is coming to Harbour Town for the RBC Heritage! Located by the 9th green at the Harbour Town Clubhouse, Fraser’s Tavern at the Pavilion will serve the restaurant’s signature smokehouse favorites, along with grab-and-go entrées and lighter options. Try the 5-Time Champion Burger created by Davis Love III. $1 from every burger sold will go to a charity supported by the Heritage Classic Foundation. Merchandise Both during and before the tournament, fans can shop a variety of exclusive tournament-branded apparel, gear, and souvenirs.HARBOUR TOWN GOLF SHOP April 11 and 12; 6:30am-6:30pm. Marina Dockage Our full-service marina in the Harbour Town Yacht Basin welcomes boaters with dockage steps away from the tournament, a welcome bottle of wine and access to resort amenities. Play Golf While at The Sea Pines Resort, play a round of golf yourself and experience the unique layouts and challenges of Atlantic Dunes by Davis Love III and Heron Point by Pete Dye. Links, an American Grill Dining Located within the Harbour Town Clubhouse and offering both indoor and outdoor seatings, Links is the premier destination for a fine dining experience at The Sea Pines Resort.
